svg.aria-label: Memory hierarchy -- who consumes the arenas and caches. coupling derived from #include edges between libs/, port/ and src/; the number on an arrow is how many files carry it in (the real story): ra8_rabook_compile - to ra8_book (6), ra8_epub - to ra8_jof (5), ra8_comic - to ra8_jof (4) ra8_rabook_import - to ra8_mem (4), ra8_zoom - to ra8_book (4), ra8_mdl_storage_vfs - to ra8_io (4) ra8_ftl - to ra8_io (3), port/esp-hosted - to ra8_io (3), ra8_reflow - to ra8_mem (3), ra8_comic - to ra8_mem (2) down: ra8_io - to ra8_core (111), ra8_mem - to ra8_core (30), ra8_io - to ra8_hal (24), ra8_io - to ra8_fs (9) Only three edges inside the layer stack, and that is the point: ra8_mem is a leaf that many unrelated libraries reach for. The interesting traffic is inbound, so the seam panel above is longer than the diagram. ra8_cache_store is grey because nothing in this set includes it and it includes none of them -- it reaches ra8_core only. Derivation: every arrow is an #include of a header owned by the target unit. CMake cannot answer this -- libs/*/CMakeLists.txt are no-ops and consumers glob libs/ lib to /src/*.c into one object library, so there are no target_link_libraries edges to read.

g.text: Memory hierarchy -- who consumes the arenas and caches
coupling derived from #include edges between libs/, port/ and src/; the number on an arrow is how many files carry it
ra8_book
XIP container
ra8_jof
band-tile atlas
ra8_io
block + page cache
ra8_mem
arenas, slabs, vmem
ra8_cache_store
persistent blob cache
seams to the rest of the tree
in (the real story): ra8_rabook_compile -> ra8_book (6), ra8_epub -> ra8_jof (5), ra8_comic -> ra8_jof (4)
ra8_rabook_import -> ra8_mem (4), ra8_zoom -> ra8_book (4), ra8_mdl_storage_vfs -> ra8_io (4)
ra8_ftl -> ra8_io (3), port/esp-hosted -> ra8_io (3), ra8_reflow -> ra8_mem (3), ra8_comic -> ra8_mem (2)
down: ra8_io -> ra8_core (111), ra8_mem -> ra8_core (30), ra8_io -> ra8_hal (24), ra8_io -> ra8_fs (9)
Only three edges inside the layer stack, and that is the point: ra8_mem is a leaf that many unrelated libraries reach for.
The interesting traffic is inbound, so the seam panel above is longer than the diagram. ra8_cache_store is grey because
nothing in this set includes it and it includes none of them -- it reaches ra8_core only.
Derivation: every arrow is an #include of a header owned by the target unit. CMake cannot answer this -- libs/*/CMakeLists.txt are
no-ops and consumers glob libs/<lib>/src/*.c into one object library, so there are no target_link_libraries edges to read.
